cases.source:
<?php
class Owner {
    public readonly int $x;
    public public(set) readonly int $y;
    public public(set) readonly int $z;
    public function __construct() { $this->x = 1; $this->y = 10; }
    public function put($value) { $this->x = $value; }
    public function __clone() {
        $GLOBALS['escaped'] = $this;
        echo 'C|'; Fiber::suspend('pause');
        try { $this->x = 3; } catch (Error $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), '|'; }
    }
}
$o = new Owner();
$fiber = new Fiber(function () use ($o) { return clone $o; });
echo $fiber->start(), '|';
$escaped->put(2); echo $escaped->x, '|';
$fiber->resume(); $c = $fiber->getReturn();
try { $c->y = 11; } catch (Error $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), '|'; }
$c->z = 9;
try { $c->z = 12; } catch (Error $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), '|'; }
echo $o->x, '/', $c->x, '/', $c->y, '/', $c->z, '/', $c === $escaped ? 'same' : 'different';

<?php
class Owner {
    public readonly int $x;
    public function __construct() { $this->x = 1; }
    public function __clone() {
        unset($GLOBALS['original']); echo 'C|'; $this->x = 2;
    }
}
$original = new Owner(); $copy = clone $original;
echo isset($original) ? 'live' : 'gone', '/', $copy->x;

<?php
class Owner {
    public readonly int $x;
    public readonly int $y;
    public readonly int $z;
    public int $mutable = 10;
    public function __construct() { $this->x = 1; unset($this->z); }
    public function __clone() {
        unset($this->x, $this->y, $this->z); echo 'U|';
        try { $this->x = []; } catch (TypeError $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), '|'; }
        echo 'F|'; $this->x = 2; $this->y = 3; $this->z = 4; echo 'W|';
    }
}
$original = new Owner(); $other = new Owner(); $copy = clone $original;
try { $copy->__clone(); } catch (Error $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), '|'; }
echo $original->x, '/', $copy->x, '/', $copy->y, '/', $copy->z, '/', $other->x;

    public function __clone() {

}
register_shutdown_function(function () {
    try { $GLOBALS['escaped']->y = 11; } catch (Error $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), '|'; }
